notes_for_editor: Two independent sources agree the Viola tower stood in Warren County (TN Landforms and the 2014 extant list). Nothing found gives a build date, design, height, owner or access rule. Record coordinates (35.56585, -85.86738) sit about 3 km north of the Wikipedia town center (35.538, -85.861); not checked against a map of the tower. The TN Landforms code '5-3' is unexplained and not used in the story. Agency is left out because the document does not name an owner for this tower. Web searches returned only genealogy and a Delaware tower page, which is a different Viola.
